name: AppSidebar
label: App sidebar
description: Collapsible navigation rail with accordion sub-items, a side panel for a third level, category headings, and a profile section.

props.name: sections
props.description: Navigation sections

props.name: profile
props.description: Profile data for the bottom section

props.name: activeKey
props.description: Key of the currently active item

props.name: activeSubKey
props.description: Key of the currently active sub-item

props.name: activeTertiaryKey
props.description: Key of the currently active third-level item, listed in the side panel

props.name: subNav
props.description:
Where an item's sub-items show. `accordion` (the default) opens them under
the row, and a sub-item's own children open in a side panel as level 3.
`panel` skips the accordion: a top-level item opens its sub-items straight
into the side panel, with their children as the panel's accordion, and the
collapsed rail shows each label under its icon. On small screens both
modes drill in inside the drawer instead.

props.name: defaultPanelOpen
props.description: Whether the side panel starts open when there is one to show

props.name: panelOpen
props.description: Controlled open state of the side panel

props.name: onPanelOpenChange
props.description: Called when the side panel opens or collapses

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether sidebar starts expanded

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Callback when expand/collapse changes

props.name: onProfileMore
props.description: Callback when profile more button clicked

props.name: layout
props.description:
How the rail meets the page, one of the three app shell modes. `flush`
runs it edge to edge on the shell colour behind a hairline divider,
nothing raised. `floating` floats it off the viewport edges as a glass card:
inset with rounded corners, the translucent glass fill over a backdrop
blur, and the floating shadow (the inset defaults to 20px and is
overridable via the --ds-sidebar-float-inset custom property). `inset`
runs it flush on the app shell colour, beside a raised content surface
inset from the edges, as AppLayout's `inset` layout draws it. Inside a
host that marks itself a shell (AppLayout, a chat or template page), the
rail reads that host's mode from the shell recipe. Defaults to
`flush` (or `floating` while the deprecated `floating` is set).

props.name: floating
props.description: Floats the rail as a glass card, the same as `layout="floating"`.

props.name: topSlot
props.description: Rendered under the logo row, above the nav; fades out while collapsed

props.name: persistentTopSlot
props.description: Keeps `topSlot` shown while collapsed instead of fading it, clipped by the sweeping rail as the nav rows are, for content that draws its own collapsed form: a switcher that holds its mark on the rail's axis and fades the rest. The slot carries `data-expanded`, so its content can key off the rail's state

props.name: footerSlot
props.description: Rendered above the profile block; fades out while collapsed

props.name: collapsedFooterSlot
props.description: Rendered above the profile block while the rail is collapsed, in `footerSlot`'s place: the same controls at their smallest, such as a SegmentedControl's or ThemeToggle's `cycle` circle, stacked and centred on the rail's axis. The two forms share one cell and crossfade with the rail, and whichever is hidden is inert

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo element — defaults to the built-in brand mark

props.name: logoText
props.description: Text shown next to logo when expanded

props.name: showMobileTrigger
props.description:
Below the mobile breakpoint the rail hides and this fixed hamburger
button opens it as an overlay drawer instead. Set false when the
host renders its own trigger in the page chrome.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the mobile hamburger trigger that opens the drawer

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle when it closes the mobile drawer

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle (and the collapsed logo) when it expands the rail

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle when it collapses the rail

props.name: profileMoreLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the profile block's more button

props.name: menuLabel
props.description:
Back-button text in the mobile drawer's drill-in when the open level
has no parent row to name (a top-level item opened with `subNav="panel"`)
